name: rds-data
description: RDS Data API Amazon RDS provides an HTTP endpoint to run SQL statements on an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.

subcommands.name: batch-execute-statement
subcommands.description: Runs a batch SQL statement over an array of data.

options.name: --resource-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Aurora Serverless DB cluster

options.name: --secret-arn
options.description: The ARN of the secret that enables access to the DB cluster. Enter the database user name and password for the credentials in the secret.

options.name: --sql
options.description: The SQL statement to run. Don't include a semicolon (;) at the end of the SQL statement

options.name: --database
options.description: The name of the database

options.name: --schema
options.description: The name of the database schema.  Currently, the schema parameter isn't supported

options.name: --parameter-sets
options.description: The parameter set for the batch operation. The SQL statement is executed as many times as the number of parameter sets provided.

options.name: --transaction-id
options.description: The identifier of a transaction that was started by using the BeginTransaction operation.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
